s.g: An act of collapsing into a state of temporary unconsciousness.
An often domesticated mammal (Mustela putorius furo) rather like a weasel, descended from the European polecat and often trained to hunt burrowing animals.
A person who fits or assembles something.
A person who sells flowers.
The acts at the beginning of a (usually human) sexual encounter that serve to build up sexual arousal.
A type of dress or clothing. [from early 17thc.]
A measure of arrows in the Middle Ages.

An eye disease or disorder that is defined as a characteristic optic neuropathy, or disease of the optic nerve, possibly, if untreated, leading to damage of the optic disc of the eye and resultant visual field loss due to lack of communication between the retina and the brain, which can lead to blindness.
Consisting of, or resembling, granules or grains.
A person who retails groceries (foodstuffs and household items) from a grocery.
(biology) state of minimum power consumption, inactivity and metabolic depression during winter
Something which hinders: something that holds back or causes problems with something else.
(US, uncountable) The process by which any organism's body develops immunity against a pathogen.
Not alive, and never having been alive, especially not like humans and animals.
Not animate.
Of or pertaining to Indo-Aryan languages and people.
A native speaker of an Indo-Aryan language.
An area to cultivate: a field
The region of the field roughly bounded by the home plate, first base, second base and third base.
To enlarge by filling with air (or a gas).
(transitive) to enlarge the volume occupied by an object
A break, especially between two performances or sessions, such as at a concert, play, seminar, or religious assembly.
The system of writing Japanese using Chinese characters.

In the International System of Units, the base unit of mass; conceived of as the mass of one litre of water, but now defined by taking the fixed numerical value of the Planck constant h to be 6.626 070 15 × 10⁻³⁴ when expressed in units of kg⋅m²⋅s⁻¹. Symbol: kg
A fixed telephone communications cable; originally, one run over land, as opposed to a submarine cable.
telephone connected by such a fixed wire
Language, especially language peculiar to a particular group, field, or region; jargon or a dialect.
Any species of game fish belonging to either of the genera Tetrapturus or Makaira, with a crested dorsal fin and a pointed, spear-like projection of the upper jaw.
Of, relating to, or containing meat.
A type of dumpling from Nepal, Ladakh or Tibet made with a simple flour and water dough and filled with meat, vegetables or cheese.
The amount that will fit in a mouth.
The meat of sheep used as food; especially, that of adults.
In the International System of Units, the derived unit of electrical resistance; the electrical resistance of a device across which a potential difference of one volt causes a current of one ampere.
A mythical evil monstrous humanoid creature, usually quite aggressive and often green.
The process of flowing out.
The act by which one thing overtakes another.
A musical introduction to a longer piece of music or a dramatic work (such as a play, an opera, or a motion picture).
In a passive manner; without conscious or self-directed action.
A spicy salami-style Italian-American sausage made from cured pork and beef seasoned with pepper.
farm tool with 2 or more tines
(geology) The Pleistocene epoch.
A steroid hormone, secreted by the ovaries, whose function is to prepare the uterus for the implantation of a fertilized ovum and to maintain pregnancy.
A puritanical person.
Acting or behaving according to the Puritan morals (e.g. propagating modesty), especially with regard to pleasure, nudity and sex; ascetic.
A goosefoot (Chenopodium quinoa) native to the Andes and cultivated for its edible seeds.
(electronics) An electric component that transmits current in direct proportion to the voltage across it.

Reddish in color, especially of the face, fire, or sky.
To compose or perform poetry or songs.
A deep cooking vessel with a long protruding handle and sometimes a lid; used for boiling, stewing and making sauces.
A split or separation within a group or organization, typically caused by discord.
One who foretells the future; a clairvoyant, prophet, soothsayer or diviner.
A serious medical condition in which the whole body is inflamed, causing injury to its own tissues and organs as a response to infection.
(not comparable) Neither parallel nor perpendicular to a certain line; askew.
The sound made by exhaling or inhaling roughly through the nose.
To make a snort; to exhale roughly through the nose.
To inhale (usually a drug) through the nose.
That which adds spice or (figurative) excitement.
The act or action of the verb to sprint (to run, cycle, etc. at top speed for a short period).
(business) A person or organisation with a legitimate interest (a stake) in a given situation, action or enterprise.
A unit of a poem, written or printed as a paragraph; equivalent to a verse.
(education) A scholarship granted to a student. [from Template:SAFESUBST: c.]
(archaic) A regular fixed payment made to someone (especially a clergyman, judge, soldier, or teacher) for services provided by them; a salary. [from Template:SAFESUBST: c.]
In a sweet or pleasant manner.
The art or practice of setting and arranging type; typesetting.
Not able to be held or sustained, such as of an opinion or position.
(astronomy) The seventh planet in our solar system, discovered in 1781 by William Herschel.
(Greek god) The Greek god who personified the sky and heavens and fathered the Titans. Roman counterpart: Caelus.
